comparison.objective: Remove two transport keys before unloading a captive carrier; candidate breaks four insert tangs and retrieves the released pieces.
comparison.physical_skill: Ordered key extraction followed by carrier unloading versus precision mandrel placement, separately manipulated hammer impact, fracture-force control, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Both keys must be physically removed before the carrier is unloaded versus four contact-driven notch fractures, complete tang containment, and no retained-part damage.
comparison.reason: Both remove small parts, but transport-key extraction and prerequisite ordering do not test manufactured-notch fracture or bimanual impact. No spec versions or detailed carrier tolerances are supplied.
